name: homebridge-daikin-accfactory
description: Homebridge support for Daikin Air-conditioning systems
author: n0rt0nthec4t

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.js src/fetchWrapper/fetchWrapper.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage test/*.test.js src/fetchWrapper/fetchWrapper.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run clean && copyfiles -u 1 src/*.js dist && copyfiles -u 2 src/HomeKitDevice/HomeKitDevice.js dist && copyfiles -u 2 src/HomeKitHistory/HomeKitHistory.js dist && copyfiles -u 2 src/fetchWrapper/fetchWrapper.js dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run format && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
